newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks pull off lows, earnings aid.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks pull off lows, earnings aid.

text.p: U.S. stocks recouped some early losses on Thursday as solid second quarter earnings reports counteracted an initial bout of profit-taking.
The Dow Jones Industrial average, which powered past the 8,000-point mark yesterday, pulled off session lows to trade down around 13 points to 8026.
Components McDonald's Corp and Merck & Co rose after releasing second quarter earnings, helping to fuel the Dow's gains.
The Nasdaq composite also recovered some, trading down around six points to 1575.
